sections.title: New
items: A scene can be queued from its info sheet without leaving the list you are browsing.
Saved filters now remember the sort order as well as the filter itself.
The performer page lists every studio the performer has worked with.
Tag cards show their parent tag, so a deep hierarchy is readable at a glance.
Galleries gained a slideshow speed setting with three fixed steps.
The player shows the remaining time on the seek bar when you press Down.
Images can be rotated in the viewer without leaving the full-screen view.
A new random button on Home opens a scene from the current tab.

sections.title: Improved
items: Listing pages now keep their scroll position when you return from a detail view.
The focus ring is easier to see on the OLED theme and on bright cover art.
Marker lists load in one request instead of one per marker.
The setup screen explains what the Test button checks before it runs.
Long tag and studio names wrap instead of running under the card edge.
Playback options open on the side of the screen that matches the cursor.
The queue remembers its order across a restart.
Search results appear sooner while you are still typing on the TV keyboard.

sections.title: Fixed
items: Back from a marker list returned to the first scene rather than the one that was playing.
A scene with no cover could leave an empty card focused at the end of a row.
The player volume stayed muted after switching from the TV engine to the browser.
A saved filter with a deleted tag now drops the tag instead of failing to run.
The image viewer could show the previous image for a moment after a fast next press.
Changing the transcode quality during playback no longer restarts the scene twice.
The settings panel could scroll behind the PIN keypad when the keyboard was open.
The update check ran twice when Settings was opened during the daily check.

sections.title: New
items: Quick filters on studio pages, matching the performer page.
The scene info sheet can open the list of scenes that share its studio.
Image viewers gained a fit and fill toggle that is remembered per device.
A new card in Search lists saved filters across every tab.
The playback options menu shows the bitrate of the stream in use.
Groups can be pinned to the top of their listing.

sections.title: Improved
items: Opening a scene from a queue no longer rebuilds the whole player.
The home shelves load one after another rather than all at once.
Covers are decoded off the main thread, so focus moves sooner on a full page.
The rail collapses its labels on narrow windows to leave more room for cards.
Error messages from a failed connection now name the step that failed.

sections.title: Fixed
items: The D-pad could leave a dialog through the edge of a focusable scroll pane.
A gallery with a single image closed the viewer after the slideshow advanced.
The TV player ignored a resume point when the scene was opened from Up next.
Backspace in the search field could close Settings while the field was focused.
The screen reader label on the queue button named the wrong action.

sections.title: Changes
items: Quick edits from the Info sheet: favourites, ratings, organised and O count.
Favourite tags and studios show a star on their cards.
Delete a saved filter from the filter builder; press twice to confirm.
Transcode quality and playback speed in Settings and the player's options.
Quick filters on a performer's scenes.
Cover art and playback now work when Stash uses an external host.
Unwatched now treats a scene with watch time or a resume point as watched.
And other minor bug fixes.
